name: stylaiize
description: StylAIze - AI Personal Stylist. See it. Style it. Buy it for less.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace @stylaiize/web" "npm run dev --workspace @stylaiize/api"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @stylaiize/shared && npm run build --workspace @stylaiize/api && npm run build --workspace @stylaiize/web
scripts.build:api: npm run build --workspace @stylaiize/shared && npm run build --workspace @stylaiize/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @stylaiize/web && npm run typecheck --workspace @stylaiize/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @stylaiize/shared
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @stylaiize/web && npm run lint --workspace @stylaiize/api
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @stylaiize/api && npm run test --workspace @stylaiize/web
